items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: It was strictly a Redd Foxx routine. And I had been tellin' jokes long before I heard him.

ctx.x: A little, 'cause I had been with the GF + I could sing harmonies, but like I wasn't a showman see Slim, I mean how do you follow him. Not me... Not at that particular time. But I wound up being another Redd Foxx and everything else. Tell jokes, dance, sing do everything else.
How did you travel with Tatum?
